messages:
mira-partnerships: Quick sync for Stirling (eu-central-5) with Helix Cloud. They want a marketplace SKU + tenant HSM for pilot. Need quotas, KMS ARNs, and a tight rollout plan.
sam-cloud: Do we have numbers? Helix mentioned 3 reserved GPUs -> burst 9. Priya, confirm?
priya-partner: Confirmed: start with 3 A10-equivalent, burst to 9 for stress tests. Need tenant isolation and private-KMS support.
luke-ops: Paste-ready quota block please and I'll file ticket. Use this format: project, region, sku, requested.
mira-partnerships: Copy block:
```
project: redwood-pilot
region: eu-central-5
sku: redwood-edge-a10
requested: 9
notes: reserved 3 for pilot, burst to 9 for stress, partner: Helix
```
nina-legal: Legal note: partner SI will get aggregated traces only. If raw prompts are needed we require DPA + SI appendix. Can Helix confirm retention policy?
priya-partner: For pilot we only need anonymized traces. We'll sign DPA appendix limiting prompt retention to 30 days.
marketplace-bot: [marketplace-bot] draft SKU: https://marketplace.internal/drafts/redwood-edge-helix-euc5. Entitlements set: tenant-isolation, private-kms.
sam-cloud: KMS: we support envelope encryption. Need service account + KMS ARN. Priya, can Helix send ARNs today?
priya-partner: Yes, sending ARNs and contact for HSM vendor now. Rotation monthly for pilot.
luke-ops: Filing quota ticket now, tagging high priority. ETA 48-72h from cloud.
mira-partnerships: Timeline ask from Helix: pilot demo week of May 20. Can we target partner canary by May 12 and reserved by May 16?
sam-cloud: May 12 is tight but doable if ARNs and quota approvals land this week. Ops/SRE need 72h to provision and test.
nina-legal: I'll draft the DPA appendix and share link in #legal today.
mira-partnerships: Next steps: 1) Priya send ARNs (today) 2) Luke file quota (done) 3) Marketplace finalize SKU (marketplace-bot) 4) Nina draft DPA appendix. Ping here with updates. :white_check_mark:
